CustomField.description: Platform Picto & Name for display purposes only
CustomField.formula: TRIM(IF(ISBLANK( TEXT(System_Platform__c) ), '', IMAGE('/resource/systemIcons/' + TEXT(System_Platform__c) + '.svg', TEXT(System_Platform__c) , 20, 20)) + ' ' + BLANKVALUE(ContractNumber, '') + '(' + BLANKVALUE(Name,'?') + ')')
CustomField.label: Name (Display)
